description: Discover the best hotels in Doha, Qatar. Find exclusive deals and luxury accommodations.

hotels.title: Doha Modern Luxury in Old Town with Five Onsite Restaurants
hotels.description: Uncover Qatar’s gorgeous heritage during your stay at Abesq Doha Hotel & Residences, located in the heart of Old Town. This contemporary hotel offers complete relaxation, with an opulent onsite spa, library and outdoor pool at your fingertips. Be spoilt for choice with five culinary destinations and hand-crafted drinks at Sprezzi pool bar, just a stroll away.

hotels.title: Qatar: Downtown Doha Luxury Retreat with Onsite Dining, Rooftop Pool & Spa
hotels.description: Perfectly positioned in the heart of Msheireb Downtown Doha, this opulent retreat places you steps from the atmospheric Souq Waqif, the Museum of Islamic Art and the Corniche waterfront promenade. Each room is a tranquil sanctuary, blending contemporary Qatari design with sweeping city views and plush comforts. Dine on refined Mexican cuisine at O'Glacée, or sample Parisian-inspired pastries at the elegant AtTeatude lounge. The rooftop pool offers panoramic vistas of Doha’s skyline, while the M|Spa features hammam rituals and holistic treatments

hotels.vendor_name: Crowne Plaza Doha The Business Park
hotels.title: Luxury Doha Escape in the Heart of Business Park with Seven Restaurants & Bars
hotels.description: Masterfully placed in the centre of Qatar's capital, Crowne Plaza Doha - The Business Park, an IHG Hotel, offers sophisticated luxury and world-renowned hospitality. This urban hideaway boasts a magnificent blend of locally inspired elements with modern amenities. Make yourself at home by the glittering pool, feast your way across seven excellent restaurants, bars and lounges, keep active at the well-equipped gym or venture beyond the hotel to explore this historic city.

hotels.vendor_name: Holiday Inn Doha - The Business Park
hotels.title: Contemporary City Break in Doha's Bustling Business and Financial District
hotels.description: With a prime location in the middle of Doha's financial district, Holiday Inn Doha - The Business Park, an IHG Hotel is a convenient home away from home. Perfect for business travellers, with a modern business centre and seven flexible meeting spaces, this contemporary hotel features an outdoor pool and fitness centre. When your work is done, relax over a coffee in the lobby or enjoy a delicious meal at the all-day dining restaurant Sirocco. Leisure isn't left behind - explore local attractions, including Souq Waqif and Doha Corniche, just a few minutes away.

hotels.title: Luxury Five-Star Escape in the Heart of Doha
hotels.description: Accept an invitation to old-world hospitality and cosmopolitan sophistication at the InterContinental Doha - The City, an IHG Hotel. Experience a quintessential Qatarian escape within an easy walk of the vibrant City Center Doha Mall, DECC Station, and the hypnotic Museum of Illusions. When not in your modern accommodation overlooking the sea or the city's sweeping skyline, relax in the swimming pool, work out at the fitness centre or head to one of seven world-class restaurants.

hotels.title: Five-Star Beachfront Doha Escape with 11 Restaurants & Bars
hotels.description: Experience the height of opulence when staying at the five-star InterContinental Doha Beach & Spa, an IHG Hotel, offering a quintessential Qatari escape. Expect dazzling city skyline and shimmering Arabian Sea views from your modern accommodation. Relax in one of the glittering swimming pools and when hunger hits, head to one of the 11 restaurants and bars. When it's time to explore Doha, you'll find yourself within close reach of Souq Waqif, The Pearl and Doha Corniche.

hotels.title: Five-Star Doha Kempinski Suites in Vibrant West Bay's Tallest Tower
hotels.description: Experience the height of opulence when staying at the five-star Kempinski Residences & Suites, Doha, a signature luxury brand housed in a soaring 256-metre tower. Expect epic views of Doha's sprawling metropolis and the prestigious West Bay during your stay. In addition to spectacular panoramas, enjoy a world of fine food at the onsite restaurants. There are three venues to explore, including a boutique bakery, a modern Mexican kitchen and authentic Pan-Asian cuisine. At the PURE Leisure & Wellness Centre, enjoy two temperature-controlled indoor swimming pools and a steam room for a chance to relax and recharge.

hotels.title: Five-Star Central Doha Glamour with Rooftop Bar, Nine Restaurants & Indoor Pool
hotels.description: Soar above the city in Doha’s buzzing Al Sadd district, where striking contemporary architecture meets Qatari elegance at this landmark address. Inside La Cigale Hotel Managed by Accor, soaring atriums, Venetian-style chandeliers, and polished cherry wood floors set the tone for an indulgent stay. Each room and suite offers plush bedding, a personalised pillow menu, and designer amenities, ensuring comfort at every turn. Culinary enthusiasts can explore nine dining venues, from Mediterranean seafood at Le Central to signature Italian fare at Di Capri, and rooftop cocktails at Sky View. Unwind with a relaxing swim in the heated indoor pool and rejuvenate with soothing treatments at the Ozone Spa. With Souq Waqif, the Museum of Islamic Art, and the Corniche nearby, this hotel is the perfect launchpad for exploring Doha’s rich culture and vibrant city life.

hotels.title: Five-Star Downtown Doha Urban Escape with Two Rooftop Swimming Pools
hotels.description: In the centre of the lively Msheireb Downtown Doha lies the elegant five-star Mandarin Oriental, Doha - a blend of both traditional Qatari heritage and urban contemporary touches. Indulge in the hotel’s nine onsite eateries and bars, ranging from innovative French Mediterranean dining to Chinese cuisine to freshly baked patisserie and cakes. Pamper yourself in the onsite spa, complete with six private treatment rooms, indoor spa pools and a gold quartz sand treatment bed. Head up to the rooftop to take a dip in one of the two temperature controlled swimming pools as you soak in views of the stunning cityscape, or venture out of the bespoke hotel into the cultural heart of the city to experience historic museums and vibrant marketplaces only moments away.

hotels.vendor_name: Marsa Malaz Kempinski, The Pearl - Doha
hotels.title: Five-Star Kempinski Luxury on Doha's The Pearl-Qatar Island with Private Beach & Outdoor Pools
hotels.description: Experience signature Kempinski service in the cosmopolitan capital of Qatar at the five-star Marsa Malaz Kempinski, The Pearl - Doha, located on The Pearl-Qatar, a blissful, man-made island. An ideal stopover or a great getaway on its own, Doha is bursting with art, culture, high-end restaurants and premium shopping. Explore the urban metropolis before retreating to your palatial accommodation, with seven restaurants and four stylish bars and lounges offering unique culinary experiences. Plus, a private beach and outdoor pools promise plenty of space to unwind and soak up the sun, while a fitness centre, tennis court, two padel courts and watersports activities will keep you up and moving during your escape.

hotels.title: Sky-High Doha Escape in Vibrant West Bay with Six Restaurants & Bars & State-of-the-Art Spa
hotels.description: Experience the epitome of Qatari hospitality at this five-star retreat, perfectly positioned in the heart of Doha's vibrant West Bay district. Pullman Doha West Bay is a playground for leisure and business travellers alike, boasting a collection of contemporary rooms, suites and apartments that offer panoramic views of the Arabian Gulf and the city's glittering skyline. The hotel's central location puts you in the middle of the action: explore the bustling Souq Waqif, brimming with aromatic spices, traditional garments and handcrafted souvenirs, or indulge in retail therapy at The Gate Mall and Doha City Centre shopping malls. Return to the hotel to savour a world of flavours at the hotel's six restaurants and bars, rejuvenate body and mind at the onsite spa, or simply kick back and relax at the outdoor pool.

hotels.title: Doha Beachfront Indulgence with Six Restaurants, Four Pools & Luxe Spa
hotels.description: Soak up sweeping Arabian Gulf views and five-star indulgence from this glamorous Rixos beachfront haven, set along Doha’s Corniche and just minutes from Souq Waqif and the Museum of Islamic Art. Savour dry-aged cuts at Mr. Tailor, Mediterranean indulgence at Akte Pier 51, and Pan-Indian favourites at Rasa. Between gourmet adventures and dips in the infinity pool, discover family fun at the Rixy Kids' Club or explore upscale shopping at nearby malls like Mall of Qatar. Whether seeking cultural immersion or seaside relaxation, this lavish oasis captures the vibrant soul of modern Doha.

hotels.title: Five-Star Doha Sky-High Escape with Luxury Day Spa & Kids' Club
hotels.description: Be part of Doha's silver skyline when you stay at the soaring voco Doha West Bay Suites, an IHG Hotel, a 46-story skyscraper with epic views and sublime service. Hungry? Enjoy a spot of fine dining on the terrace at The Social, or snack on light bites and fruity mocktails at Serenitea cafe. Bored? Take a dip in the vast outdoor swimming pool, leave the kids to explore the fun kids' club and game room, or be pampered at the tranquil Al Jawhary Salon and Spa. There's something for everyone here.

hotels.title: Five-Star Doha Katara Towers Luxury with Arabian Gulf Views
hotels.description: Experience the epitome of Doha's modern luxury at this sophisticated sanctuary housed within the iconic Katara Towers overlooking the picturesque Arabian Gulf. From the majestic architectural design of the Katara Towers to the meticulously curated guest rooms and suites, every aspect of your stay exudes elegance and refinement. Indulge in the opulence of your exquisitely appointed accommodation offering breathtaking views of the Arabian Gulf or the vibrant Lusail City skyline. With world-class service and state-of-the-art amenities, Fairmont Doha ensures that your stay is nothing short of extraordinary.

hotels.title: Doha Icon: Raffles Oceanfront Opulence in Katara Towers with Butler Service & Six Onsite Eateries
hotels.description: Rising dramatically from the Lusail Marina skyline, Raffles Doha occupies the iconic Katara Tower - a landmark inspired by Qatar’s crossed swords. Here, unparalleled opulence meets Middle‑Eastern grandeur, with sweeping views of the Arabian Gulf and Doha’s cityscape. All-suite residences envelop guests in refined elegance, with rich textiles, carved ceilings and polished marble - plus bespoke butler service. Dining is an artform with six onsite restaurants and bars, from Northern Italian cuisine at Alba to the Middle-Eastern glamour of Malaki Lounge and rooftop Acoustic Music Penthouse, where skyline views and live music set the scene. Between city explorations and fine dining, retreat to Raffles Spa & Wellness Doha for an indulgent treatment or a poolside cabana to soak in sky-high luxury.
